examples.text: tassa me sahāyo suhadayo, saddho āsi upāsako, tassa kul'upako bhikkhu, āsi gotamasāvako, so'pi maṃ anukampanto, nivāresi punappunaṃ.

22593.meaning1: who approaches families; who visits houses
22593.meaning2: (being) a family associate; (one) dependent on, intimate with, household or several households

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, kathaṃrūpo bhikkhu arahati kul'ūpako hotuṃ, kathaṃrūpo bhikkhu na arahati kul'ūpako hotun'ti?

22595.meaningLit: discourse on one who approaches families

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā kul'ūpage. katame pañca?

22597.commentary: (SNa) kul'ūpaghātaṃ maññe carasī'ti kulāni upaghātento viya hananto viya āhiṇḍasi.

examples.text: atha kiñ'carahi tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, imehi navehi bhikkhūhi indriyesu aguttadvārehi bhojane amattaññūhi jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttehi saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carasi? sassaghātaṃ maññe carasi, kul'ūpaghātaṃ maññe carasi. olujjati kho te, āvuso ānanda, parisā, palujjanti kho te, āvuso, navappāyā.

22598.meaning2: (being) a family associate; (one) dependent on, intimate with, household or several households

22599.commentary: (KVa) kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti yasmiṃ kule nimantito, tato aññāni kulāni paviseyya.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjati. tam'enaṃ bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, m'āyasmā ativelaṃ kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjī'ti.
